title: Dataset for: Potato NPT Trials Amidst Prolonged Rains in Kenyan Regions -October 2009
description: The Potato NPT Trials Amidst Prolonged Rains in Kenyan Regions took place in  October of 2009 in various locations including Kibirichia, Kisima, Molo, Naraok, Oljoro, Tigoni, Baraka, and Limuru. The study was conducted under a randomized complete block design (RCBD) with eight potato clones and four replications, aiming to assess the performance of these clones in challenging weather conditions characterized by extended periods of rainfall.
data_citation: Bonierbale, Merideth; Gastelo, Manuel (2023). Dataset for: Potato NPT Trials Amidst Prolonged Rains in Kenyan Regions -October 2009. International Potato Center. Version 2.1. doi:10.21223/FBZ6JS
